prohibited_inferences: Do not treat this synthetic fixture as evidence about Electric Twin, News UK, Dentsu, or any named deployment.
Do not infer preference conversion from a retained or responding share.
Do not infer that exit, churn, or nonresponse means dislike without identified reasons and exposure state.
Do not discard organized refusal as ordinary missing data.
Do not infer manipulative intent from attrition-conditioned measurement.
Do not infer public authorization from a normalized active-user metric.

interpretation_contract.what_this_is: A deterministic synthetic control showing that genuine preference conversion, selective exit, and strategic nonresponse can produce the same normalized observed 80/20 headline while the full population outcomes remain materially different.
interpretation_contract.what_this_is_not: A real deployment finding, a universal model of exit or nonresponse, evidence of preference manipulation, or evidence of intent.
interpretation_contract.copy_ready_caveat: This fixture proves a denominator and disposition identification problem: the same normalized observed share can arise from preference change, selective exit, or strategic silence, so the headline cannot identify population support without complete attrition and response custody.
